Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'. molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno. molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno. compound_structures ON child.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. compound_records ON child.molregno = compound_records.molregno. docs ON compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id. activities ON compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id. assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id. target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'. activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
